With --no-save-ide-settings on the command line, and a proxy in front of the host object that records each SaveIDESetting call and drops it:
1. Cancel in the New / Open Project dialog calls SaveIDESetting for NEWFRONTPAGE.
2. A change of view in the Object Browser calls it for OBJECT_BROWSER.
3. savePublisherInfo calls it for PUBLISHER.
4. On a first run g_DontSaveIdeSettings is still false at the licence agreement, and I AGREE calls it for LICENCEAGREEMENTV3 and ALLOWERRORREPORTINGV3.
